en.name: Snape
en.ability: Each night, choose a player (Not Yourself). The chosen player is safe from Minion abilities during the night and the following day.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose a player (Not Yourself). The chosen player is safe from Minion abilities during the night and the following day.

en.flavor: The Dark Arts are many, varied, ever-changing and eternal. Fighting them is like fighting a many-headed monster, which, each time a neck is severed, sprouts a head even fiercer and cleverer than before
en.firstNightReminder: Wake them to choose a player
en.otherNightReminder: Wake them to choose a player
